arxiv-2002-06465.title: Information-Flow Interfaces
arxiv-2002-06465.creator: Ezio Bartocci, Thomas Ferrère, Thomas A. Henzinger, Dejan Nickovic, Ana Oliveira da Costa
arxiv-2002-06465.description: Abstract Contract-based design is a promising methodology for taming the complexity of developing sophisticated systems. A formal contract distinguishes between assumptions , which are constraints that the designer of a component puts on the environments in which the component can be used safely, and guarantees , which are promises that the designer asks from the team that implements the component.

arxiv-2209-08714.title: Finitude of physical measures for random maps
arxiv-2209-08714.creator: Pablo G. Barrientos, Fumihiko Nakamura, Yushi Nakano, Hisayoshi Toyokawa
arxiv-2209-08714.description: Abstract = Abstract. For random compositions of independent and identically distributed measurable maps on a Polish space, we study the existence and finitude of absolutely continuous ergodic stationary probability measures (which are, in particular, physical measures) whose basins of attraction cover the whole space almost everywhere.

arxiv-2305-03192.title: LSTM Framework for Classification of Radar and Communications Signals Thanks: This work was supported by project PID2020-113979RB-C21 founded by MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033.
arxiv-2305-03192.creator: Victoria Clerico 1 (Student Member, IEEE), Jorge González-López 1 , Gady Agam 2 , Jesús Grajal 1 (Senior Member, IEEE)
arxiv-2305-03192.description: Abstract Although radar and communications signal classification are usually treated separately, they share similar characteristics, and methods applied in one domain can be potentially applied in the other. We propose a simple and unified scheme for the classification of radar and communications signals using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks.

arxiv-2306-06611.creator: Yi Li, Honghao Lin, Simin Liu, Ali Vakilian, David P. Woodruff
arxiv-2306-06611.description: Abstract We consider sketching algorithms which first compress data by multiplication with a random sketch matrix, and then apply the sketch to quickly solve an optimization problem, e.g., low-rank approximation and regression. arxiv-2404-02052.title: Noise Masking Attacks and Defenses for Pretrained Speech Models
arxiv-2404-02052.creator: Matthew Jagielski, Om Thakkar, Lun Wang
arxiv-2404-02052.description: Abstract Speech models are often trained on sensitive data in order to improve model performance, leading to potential privacy leakage. Our work considers noise masking attacks, introduced by Amid et al. [ 1 ] , which attack automatic speech recognition (ASR) models by requesting a transcript of an utterance which is partially replaced with noise.

arxiv-2503-12543.title: A quantitative analysis of Galilei’s observations of Jupiter satellites from the Sidereus Nuncius
arxiv-2503-12543.creator: Andrea Longhin
arxiv-2503-12543.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Andrea Longhin. We analyse the observations of the satellites of Jupiter from the Sidereus Nuncius (January 7 to March 1, 1610) and compare them to the predictions obtained using a modern sky simulator, verifying them one by one. A sinusoidal fit of the data obtained from the 64 available sketches, allows measuring the relative major semi-axes of the satellites’ orbits and their periods with a statistical precision of 2-4% and 0.1-0.3% respectively.

arxiv-2504-09557.title: Improved regularity for a nonlocal dead-core problem
arxiv-2504-09557.creator: Disson dos Prazeres, Rafayel Teymurazyan, José Miguel Urbano
arxiv-2504-09557.description: Abstract . We obtain improved regularity results for solutions to a nonlocal dead-core problem at branching points. Our approach, which does not rely on the maximum principle, introduces a new strategy for analyzing two-phase problems within the local framework, an area that remains largely unexplored. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 35R09, Secondary 35J60, 35B65, 35B53 1.

arxiv-2511-20932.creator: Vu Phan and Ilie Ugarcovici
arxiv-2511-20932.description: Abstract . We investigate the expected number of calls required to achieve Bingo in a generalized ( n , m ) (n,m) -Bingo game, where each n × n n\times n card is filled by sampling n n numbers from m m possible values per column.

pmc-11504391.title: The association of increased SNAP benefits during COVID-19 with food insufficiency and anxiety among US adults: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-11504391.creator: Kaitlyn E Jackson, Amy Yunyu Chiang, Rita Hamad
pmc-11504391.description: Objectives:The COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent policy response to mitigate disease spread had far-reaching impacts on health and social well-being. In response, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) underwent several pandemic-era modifications, including a 15 % monthly benefit increase on January 1, 2021.

pmc-12820894.title: A Novel Ultrasound Window for Simultaneous Botulinum Neurotoxin Injection Into Three Deep Leg Muscles in Ankle and Foot Spasticity Patterns
pmc-12820894.creator: Diogo Portugal, Klemens Fheodoroff, Miguel Reis e Silva, Jorge Jacinto
pmc-12820894.description: Ankle and foot conditions with muscle overactivity often require botulinum neurotoxin (BoNT) injections into the flexor digitorum longus (FDL), tibialis posterior (TP), and flexor hallucis longus (FHL) muscles. This manuscript introduces a novel ultrasound (US) window for simultaneous BoNT injections into these muscles to improve efficiency and patient comfort in treating ankle and foot spasticity.

pmc-13031619.title: A robust strategy for FE model updating of composite panels using a combined ANN-SMA surrogate-assisted optimization framework
pmc-13031619.creator: Mohsen Kouhi, Alireza Mojtahedi, Mohammad Ali Lotfollahi-Yaghin
pmc-13031619.description: This study presents a novel hybrid surrogate-assisted optimization framework for finite element (FE) model updating of composite panels. Accurately updated FE models offer a reliable basis for design and analysis of modern structural systems and are widely employed in various industrial and engineering applications.

pmc-13080909.title: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor–Associated Myocarditis With Multisystem Immune Toxicity in Renal Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13080909.creator: Raj Nandan Chennuri, Makarand Madine, Reshmanth Prathipati, Raam Mannam, Sandhya Rani Reddy, Prudhvi Davala, Jaswinder Kaur Chilana, Fazal Bari
pmc-13080909.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitors are widely used in the adjuvant treatment of renal cell carcinoma. Although immune-related adverse effects are well described, myocarditis remains an uncommon complication. Ealy multisystem immune-related toxicity after limited exposure to therapy is uncommon and may be difficult to recognize in older patients.

pmc-13137966.title: Letter to the Editor: Combination of FTO and BTK inhibitors synergistically suppresses the malignancy of breast cancer cells
pmc-13137966.creator: Meichen Liu, Ziqi Zhao
pmc-13137966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). d the synergistic anti-tumor effect of FTO and BTK inhibitors (FB23 and Ibrutinib) in breast cancer and initially disclosed the molecular mechanism of their regulation of tumor malignant behavior through the m6A-YTHDF2-c-Myc/E2F1 axis. This work not only offers a novel combination strategy for the targeted treatment of breast cancer but also deepens our comprehension of the function of m6A modification in tumor progression. Herein, we intend to put forward several insights from the perspectives of academic and clinical translation for further investigation.

pmc-13494324.title: Osteochondral Lesions of the Talus Treated With Particulated Juvenile Cartilage Allograft in the Active Duty Military Population
pmc-13494324.creator: Colin Mizuo, Liliya Parkman, Tarina Ayazi, Haoning Hu, Ashley Adams
pmc-13494324.description: Background:Osteochondral defects (OCDs) of the talus frequently affect young, active individuals and carry a risk of chronic pain and joint degeneration. Particulated juvenile cartilage allograft (PJCA), harnesses the proliferative capacity of juvenile chondrocytes to restore hyaline cartilage without donor-site morbidity. This study evaluates the structural, clinical, and functional outcomes of PJCA implantation in active-duty military patients.

pmc-13580111.title: Is AI Capable of Real-World Drug Discovery?
pmc-13580111.creator: Georgia McGaughey
pmc-13580111.description: Small-molecule drug discovery frequently operates in regimes where slight structural changes have large consequences. These are situations in which current artificial intelligence (AI) methods, trained on mass data, may perform poorly. For a substantial fraction of drug-discovery projects, limited biological understanding and sparse data further constrain progress and define regimes where AI approaches remain difficult to apply.

pmc-13624462.title: A comparative analysis of cardiac bridging Integrator 1 (cBIN1) levels in patients with heart failure and healthy controls: A prospective case-control study
pmc-13624462.creator: Azhar Iqbal, Ruqaya Nangrejo, Muhammad Nauman Khan, Qamar Aziz
pmc-13624462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives:To compare cardiac bridging integrator 1 (cBIN1) levels between healthy individuals and patients with heart failure (HF), and to assess changes in cBIN1 levels following therapeutic intervention to evaluate its potential as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker.Methodology:A case-control study with three months follow-up was conducted in the Department of Physiology, Baqai University Hospital, Karachi, Pakistan, from June 2024 to November 2024.

pmc-13677066.title: AI-bioinformatics synergy for precision medicine in brain diseases: integrating radiomics and multi-omics data
pmc-13677066.creator: Bekir Altas, Polymnia Georgiou, Anna Onisiforou
pmc-13677066.description: The convergence of artificial intelligence (AI) and bioinformatics is reshaping the landscape of precision medicine in brain diseases, particularly in neurological diseases and brain tumors. Despite advances in both fields, the combined application of radiomics and multi-omics fusion remains underutilized, even though integrative frameworks are essential for addressing the complexity and heterogeneity of imaging and molecular data.
